rules: When reduced to 0 HP, Adaptable prevents death and it revives into Phase 2.
Cards with on-kill or Fatal triggers (Feed, The Hunt, Knockout Blow, Sunder, and Hand of Greed) will trigger successfully during any of the Test Subject's phases.

Because the Test Subject is a Boss in Act 3, after which there are no opportunities to spend Gold or earn card rewards, Feed, Knockout Blow, and Sunder are the only cards with an on-kill or Fatal trigger that matters.
Test Subject starts each save as Test Subject #C8 with the number increasing by 2 each time it's killed.
The three listed bodies are sequential phases, not simultaneous enemies; Adaptable revives the next phase.
Each transition removes all status effects and the body cannot be targeted until it revives.
timing: Cards with on-kill or Fatal triggers (Feed, The Hunt, Knockout Blow, Sunder, and Hand of Greed) will trigger successfully during any of the Test Subject's phases.

Because the Test Subject is a Boss in Act 3, after which there are no opportunities to spend Gold or earn card rewards, Feed, Knockout Blow, and Sunder are the only cards with an on-kill or Fatal trigger that matters.
On-kill and Fatal effects trigger on each phase transition.

record.name: Test Subject

pattern.text: Starts with Adaptable and Enrage 3. Alternates between Bite and Skull Bash. When reduced to 0 HP, Adaptable prevents death and it revives into Phase 2.
Revives with 551 HP, gains Painful Stabs and loses Enrage. Uses Multi-Claw every turn. Multi-Claw starts at 3 hits and gains +1 hit each use. When reduced to 0 HP again, it revives into Phase 3.
